_about: Material property table used for mass, time, cost and compatibility estimates. Values are typical published ranges for generic filaments, NOT measured on this printer. Calibrate against research/print-log.csv.

PLA.notes: Default decorative + structural material. Brittle in thin cantilevers; softens ~55-60 C (do not leave in a hot car).

PETG.notes: Tougher, more heat resistant (~75 C). Poor fusion to PLA - use mechanical interlocks, never rely on a PLA/PETG fused interface.

TPU.notes: Non-slip pads, flexible tails, bump-proof horns. Print slowly. Avoid features thinner than 1.2 mm and long unsupported bridges.

SILK_PLA.notes: Premium sheen (gold/copper) for collector variants. Weaker layer adhesion than plain PLA.

GLOW_PLA.notes: Glow-in-the-dark accents. Abrasive: use a hardened nozzle on the tool it is loaded in.

bonding._about: Fused-interface bond quality between two materials printed in contact. good = rely on it; fair = add a mechanical interlock; poor = never fuse, use separate parts or interlocks only.
